grupo-hormesis.title: Grupo Hormesis
grupo-hormesis.short: Automated B2B lead harvesting and real-time interactive culinary proposal engine powered by generative AI and Google Maps.
grupo-hormesis.long: Grupo Hormesis is an enterprise SaaS platform and B2B operational engine designed for digital transformation agencies. It automates the end-to-end consultative sales cycle for hospitality: from intelligent lead harvesting on Google Maps to profile enrichment (authentic high-res venue photos, verified reviews, operating hours, and menus) and instantaneous rendering of immersive, high-converting web proposals featuring zero-commission reservations.
grupo-hormesis.challenge: Traditional web sales in the hospitality sector require hours of manual wireframing per prospect, suffering from low conversion rates when using generic stock templates. Early AI generation approaches caused visual hallucinations: out-of-context corporate copy, illegible color contrasts, and broken mobile layouts. The core challenge was building a deterministic system capable of extracting a venue's real physical identity in seconds and rendering stable, hyper-personalized proposals without manual human intervention.
grupo-hormesis.solution: Architected a decoupled two-tier infrastructure: 1) Deterministic Culinary Engine featuring 8 hyper-optimized layout archetypes ensuring WCAG contrast compliance, responsive fluidity, and layout stability; 2) AI Enrichment & Fusion Pipeline integrating Google Places API, Cloudinary asset optimization, and Gemini AI for contextual culinary copywriting; 3) Server-side Auto-Healing system for legacy proposals coupled with an isolated React 19 sandbox admin portal.
features: 8 Deterministic Culinary Archetypes: Specialized interactive menus, dish pairings, and allergen badges
Automated Google Places API Enrichment: Real venue HD imagery, live ratings, customer reviews, and hours
Cloudinary CDN & Optimization: Cloud asset streaming with on-the-fly WebP compression and transformations
Gemini Culinary Copy Engine: Context-aware AI parsing original prospect sites to generate signature dish copy
Commission-Free Direct Booking Widget: Frictionless table reservation trigger via quick call or direct WhatsApp
Proposal Auto-Healing System: Server-side detection of outdated copy with instantaneous runtime regeneration
Programmable Asynchronous Workflows: Scheduled cron jobs orchestrating Maps scraping and cold outreach
React 19 Admin & Audit Dashboard: Sandboxed iframe preview, full-screen inspection, and 1-click regeneration
process: Data Modeling & Schema: PostgreSQL relational architecture via Prisma ORM for leads, workflows, and audit logs
Ingestion & Scraping Pipeline: Microservices for geographic Google Maps extraction and target website parsing
Culinary Visual Engine: Deterministic HTML/CSS generator with Google Fonts pairings and fluid micro-interactions
AI Orchestration & Background Workers: Resilient execution engine featuring rate limiting, retries, and Gemini synthesis
Administrative Frontend: React 19 dashboard with deep audit modals, sandboxed preview, and dynamic REST API controls
Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Containerized production delivery with Nixpacks on Railway for both API and client

results.label: Reduction in commercial proposal turnaround (from 2h to <25s)
Visual fidelity with authentic venue photos & verified Google reviews
Contrast errors or layout overflows via deterministic engine

scuti.title: Scuti Web App Beta

scuti.long: Scuti is a comprehensive Peer-to-Peer (P2P) learning and skill exchange platform aimed at democratizing education. It empowers users to consume interactive courses, become mentors, and exchange skills ('Swaps') directly with other members. By blending traditional e-learning tools like virtual whiteboards and modular curricula with social community features, it creates an immersive ecosystem for professional and personal growth.
scuti.challenge: Designing a unified system that seamlessly integrates traditional e-learning tools with a peer-to-peer exchange model and a social community, while managing complex scheduling and payments.
scuti.solution: Built a robust, highly-typed architecture using React 19 and Vite for the frontend, and Node.js with Prisma on the backend. The platform includes a multi-level course creator wizard, a real-time social feed, an innovative 'Swap' module for skill trading, and a secure internal fintech ecosystem for payments and coin management.

about.title: About Me
text: I combine 8+ years of full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, and data science. Throughout my career, I have delivered products from scratch for fast-moving startups as well as large-scale enterprise systems (including planning and logistics platforms for multinational enterprises like AB InBev).

I understand both worlds: the agile, pragmatic speed required by a startup to validate and ship, as well as the security, strict typing, scalability, and high-concurrency standards expected by established companies.

My philosophy is straightforward: continuous working staging demos every week, direct async communication without sales intermediaries, and clean, modular code that is 100% owned by your organization from day one.
